jobs.title: Hotel Safety & Security Officer
jobs.description:
HEI Hotels & Resorts in The Woodlands, TX is seeking a security professional responsible for protective, preventative, safety, and security-related enforcement across the hotel complex. You will ensure guest and staff safety, monitor life safety systems, and respond calmly to emergencies and disturbances throughout the property.

The role emphasizes mobility, situational awareness, and clear communication with supervisors and guests.

jobs.title: Luxury Hotel Security Officer — Guest Safety & Response
jobs.description:
Four Seasons Hotel Houston is seeking a security officer to join the Security team. You will participate in day-to-day security operations to ensure safety for guests, staff and property. A flexible schedule including days, evenings, weekends and holidays is expected.

Applicants should have basic English proficiency; prior law enforcement or security experience is preferred but not mandatory. We offer competitive pay, training, and staff benefits at Four Seasons.
